summary: Name unowned scope paths and their owning workstream in GOV-WORK-START-001

delivery.outcome: GOV-WORK-START-001 scope rejections name each unowned --path pattern and the workstream that owns it, an unknown workstream with the declared ones, or a tracking-only scope, instead of one generic message.
nonGoals: No change to which scopes are admitted
No change to the allocation (create) failure path or exit codes

architecture.decision: Raise ScopeOwnershipError from scoped_paths with a message built only from validated caller patterns (redacted unless [A-Za-z0-9._*/-]) and manifest workstream names; main prints it for the scope command and keeps the generic message for every other failure.

validation.evidence: Unowned, ownerless, unknown-workstream and unsafe-character cases produce precise, redacted messages; owned scope still passes.
Existing allocation and work-start suites and governance pass.
